title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
title_zh: 软件工程大语言模型：为什么我们需要它们以及软件工程如何帮助构建它们

paragraphs.en: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture’s tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE’s role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.

paragraphs.en: Strong coding performance, however, does not guarantee the engineering capabilities required to maintain and evolve software. Whitfill et al. [ 59 ] found that automated benchmark scores exceeded estimated maintainer acceptance rates by 24.2 percentage points, but code quality and compatibility were reported concerns. Open-source evidence reveals problems after merge: across 182 repositories, Xia and Miller [ 60 ] found higher corrective-maintenance rates for agentic code and associated higher rates of unreviewed merges with greater maintenance burden. Software engineering requires more than completing difficult programming tasks. Engineers must preserve compatibility, manage dependencies, remove unnecessary code, and maintain systems as requirements evolve. Refactoring is one such software engineering capability that goes beyond code generation. Refactoring supports long-term maintainability by improving software structure while preserving behavior [ 16 , 29 ] . Although developers increasingly delegate refactoring to coding agents, which pair coding LLMs with harnesses that supply tools and prompts [ 24 ] , frontier coding LLMs perform unevenly across these operations. To examine this gap, we evaluated GPT-5.2 and GLM-5.1 on RefactorBench, which contains repository-level, multi-file refactoring tasks across 13 operation categories (see Section IV for the evaluation setup). The models achieved overall success rates of 62% (GPT-5.2) and 51% (GLM-5.1), but both failed every Extract Class task. GPT-5.2 also failed every Move Class and Introduce Parameter Object (Figure 1 ). These results reveal that even highly capable coding LLMs struggle with established software engineering operations.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，强大的编码表现并不能保证具备维护和演进软件所需的工程能力。Whitfill 等人 [ 59 ] 发现，自动化基准分数比估计的维护者接受率高出 24.2 个百分点，但代码质量和兼容性是受访者报告的担忧。 开源证据揭示了合并后的问题：Xia 和 Miller 在 182 个仓库中发现，智能体代码的纠错性维护率更高，且未经审查的合并率更高，维护负担也更大 [ 60 ] 。 软件工程不仅仅是完成困难的编程任务。 工程师必须保持兼容性、管理依赖项、移除不必要的代码，并在需求演进时维护系统。 重构就是这样一种超越代码生成的软件工程能力。 重构通过在保持行为不变的前提下改进软件结构，从而支持长期可维护性 [ 16 , 29 ] 。 尽管开发者越来越多地将重构委托给编码智能体——即编码 LLM 与提供工具和提示的运行框架相结合 [ 24 ] ——但前沿编码 LLM 在这些操作上的表现并不均衡。 为考察这一差距，我们在 RefactorBench 上评估了 GPT-5.2 和 GLM-5.1，该基准包含跨 13 个操作类别的仓库级、多文件重构任务（评估设置见第 IV 节）。 两个模型的总体成功率为 62%（GPT-5.2）和 51%（GLM-5.1），但它们都未能完成任何 Extract Class 任务。 GPT-5.2 也未能完成任何 Move Class 和 Introduce Parameter Object 任务（图 1 ）。 这些结果表明，即使是非常强大的编码 LLM 也难以应对成熟的软件工程操作。

paragraphs.en: What coding LLMs learn depends on the training data developers can provide and the improvements they reward. Pretraining develops broad programming knowledge, while subsequent specialization and post-training strengthen selected capabilities through curated data and feedback. Rajbahadur et al. [ 42 ] describe post-training as programming with data: training examples act as instructions, their mixture forms the program, and the checkpoint is the compiled result. Repository histories and executable tests make issue resolution an attractive training target, as SWE-Gym and SWE-smith demonstrate [ 37 , 64 ] . OpenAI, Anthropic, and Microsoft describe evaluation-driven development, where measured weaknesses guide subsequent improvements [ 35 , 5 , 52 ] . Under finite budgets, public leaderboard incentives can further steer training toward benchmark gains, which Chen et al. [ 10 ] call benchmaxxing . This practice raises three challenges. First (C1) , data availability and evaluation priorities can leave gaps in verified training data needed to improve specific engineering capabilities and demonstrate those improvements [ 19 ] . Second (C2) , benchmark-oriented gains do not consistently transfer to other coding tasks [ 46 ] . Third (C3) , training trajectories encode harness-specific conventions, and improvements can diminish or reverse when the harness changes [ 39 , 51 ] . These challenges highlight the limits of relying on readily available training data and benchmark gains to develop engineering competence systematically.
paragraphs.zh: 编程大模型学到什么，取决于开发者能够提供的训练数据以及他们所奖励的改进方向。 预训练赋予模型广泛的编程知识，而后续的专门化与后训练则通过精选数据和反馈来强化选定的能力。Rajbahadur 等人 [ 42 ] 将后训练描述为用数据编程：训练样本如同指令，它们的组合构成程序，而检查点则是编译的结果。 仓库历史与可执行测试使问题解决成为颇具吸引力的训练目标，正如 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-smith 所展示的 [ 37 , 64 ] 。 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Microsoft 描述了一种评估驱动的开发方式，即以测量出的弱点来指导后续改进 [ 35 , 5 , 52 ] 。 在有限预算下，公开排行榜的激励机制会进一步把训练引向基准成绩的提升，Chen 等人将此称为 [ 10 ] benchmaxxing（刷榜）。 这种做法引发了三个挑战。 第一（C1），数据的可得性与评估的优先级可能导致缺乏经过验证的训练数据，而这些数据正是提升特定工程能力并证明这些提升所需要的 [ 19 ] 。 第二（C2），面向基准的收益并不总能迁移到其他编程任务上 [ 46 ] 。 第三（C3），训练轨迹会编码特定执行框架的约定，当执行框架改变时，改进可能减弱甚至逆转 [ 39 , 51 ] 。 这些挑战凸显了依赖现成训练数据和基准成绩来系统性培养工程能力的局限性。

paragraphs.en: A coding LLM serving diverse engineering workloads needs capabilities that extend beyond the benchmarks and harnesses used to develop them. Our team maintains a coding LLM used by over 100,000 developers across diverse repositories, workflows, and systems that have evolved over decades (Section II ). Developers access the coding LLM through different coding agents and rely on it to maintain existing software as well as implement new functionality. We therefore explored a complementary hypothesis, which we call capability-focused training : strengthening a foundational engineering capability can improve the related tasks and workflows that depend on it. We selected refactoring as an initial case because it exercises code localization, dependency reasoning, coordinated modification, and behavior preservation. The challenge was to construct reliable training data for these operations and determine whether the improvements transferred beyond the targeted tasks and training harness.
paragraphs.zh: 一个服务于多种工程工作负载的编码大语言模型，所需要的能力超出了用于开发它的基准测试和评测框架的范围。 我们的团队维护着一个编码大语言模型，超过 100,000 名开发者在跨越数十年演进的多样化代码仓库、工作流程和系统中使用它（第 II 节）。 开发者通过不同的编码智能体访问该编码大语言模型，并依靠它来维护现有软件以及实现新功能。 因此，我们探索了一个互补性的假设，我们称之为面向能力的训练：强化一项基础工程能力，可以改进依赖于该能力的相关任务和工作流程。 我们选择重构作为首个案例，因为它涉及代码定位、依赖推理、协同修改以及行为保持。 挑战在于为这些操作构建可靠的训练数据，并确定改进能否迁移到目标任务和训练框架之外。

sents.en: We therefore explored a complementary hypothesis, which we call capability-focused training : strengthening a foundational engineering capability can improve the related tasks and workflows that depend on it.
sents.zh: 因此，我们探索了一个互补性的假设，我们称之为面向能力的训练：强化一项基础工程能力，可以改进依赖于该能力的相关任务和工作流程。

sents.en: We selected refactoring as an initial case because it exercises code localization, dependency reasoning, coordinated modification, and behavior preservation.
sents.zh: 我们选择重构作为首个案例，因为它涉及代码定位、依赖推理、协同修改以及行为保持。

sents.en: The challenge was to construct reliable training data for these operations and determine whether the improvements transferred beyond the targeted tasks and training harness.
sents.zh: 挑战在于为这些操作构建可靠的训练数据，并确定改进能否迁移到目标任务和训练框架之外。

paragraphs.en: If post-training is programming with data, software engineering (SE) expertise should help write the program. Decades of SE research and practices have produced knowledge and tools for specifying, modifying, and verifying software. We argue that this knowledge should shape what coding LLMs learn, not merely evaluate their outputs or establish safeguards around them. Prior systems such as EM-Assist and RefactoringMirror combine LLMs with program analysis and IDE tools to support individual refactorings [ 41 , 30 ] . RefactorForge applies established SE techniques to construct verifiable training data for improving the model itself, with refactoring as the organizing capability. Refactoring preconditions and program analysis identify eligible examples, PyCharm and Ruff construct reference transformations, and structural and regression tests that determine which teacher-generated trajectories qualify for training. Building this data presents challenges. For example, repository histories can intertwine refactorings with other changes, while LLM-generated transformations require independent verification. We therefore began with seven bounded, tool-verifiable refactoring types, predominantly renames. We report the data construction process, empirical outcomes, and engineering lessons as an industrial case study rather than proposing a new training algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 如果后训练是用数据来编程，那么软件工程（SE）专业知识应当有助于编写这个程序。 数十年的软件工程研究与实践已经积累了用于规约、修改和验证软件的知识与工具。 我们主张，这些知识应当塑造代码大语言模型所学习的内容，而不仅仅是评估其输出或在其周围建立安全防护。 诸如 EM-Assist 和 RefactoringMirror 之类的先前系统将大语言模型与程序分析和 IDE 工具相结合，以支持单个重构操作 [41, 30]。 RefactorForge 应用成熟的软件工程技术来构建可验证的训练数据，以改进模型本身，并将重构作为核心组织能力。 重构前置条件和程序分析用于识别合格样本，PyCharm 和 Ruff 用于构建参考变换，而结构测试和回归测试则决定哪些由教师模型生成的轨迹有资格用于训练。 构建这些数据面临诸多挑战。 例如，仓库历史可能将重构与其他变更交织在一起，而大语言模型生成的变换则需要独立验证。 因此，我们从七种有界的、可由工具验证的重构类型入手，以重命名为主。 我们将数据构建过程、实证结果和工程经验教训作为工业案例研究报告，而非提出一种新的训练算法。

paragraphs.en: Our results indicate that SE-guided training data can improve a targeted engineering capability and transfer to related tasks that are not explicitly covered during training. RefactorForge constructed 5,704 executable tasks from 306 Python repositories and retained 4,572 verified trajectories. For C1, incremental fine-tuning of an existing 92B coding LLM on these trajectories, comprising 72.51 million tokens, i.e., 0.46% of its preceding coding mixture, improved performance by 18.00 percentage points on RefactorBench and 7.06 points on SWE-Bench ProMax . The gains extended to related SWE issue-resolution tasks (C2), with improvements of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Although we collected the training trajectories using OpenCode, the fine-tuned coding LLM achieved higher average scores under all four evaluated harnesses (C3), including a statistically significant improvement under Mini-SWE-Agent on SWE-Bench Verified ( p = 0.002 p=\mathrm{0.002} ). Transfer remained task-dependent: performance on greenfield repository generation improved under two harnesses but regressed under two others. These findings demonstrate the potential of training interventions focused on a bounded capability, while underscoring the challenges of consistent transfer across tasks and harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，SE 引导的训练数据能够提升一项针对性的工程能力，并可迁移到训练中未明确覆盖的相关任务。 RefactorForge 从 306 个 Python 仓库中构建了 5,704 个可执行任务，并保留了 4,572 条经过验证的轨迹。 对于 C1，在包含 7251 万 token（即占其先前编码混合数据 0.46%）的这些轨迹上，对一个现有的 92B 编码大语言模型进行增量微调，使其在 RefactorBench 上的性能提升了 18.00 个百分点，在 SWE-Bench ProMax 上提升了 7.06 分。 这些收益还扩展到相关的软件工程问题解决任务（C2），在 SWE-Bench Verified 上提升了 4.97 分，在 SWE-Bench Pro 上提升了 1.23 分。 尽管我们使用 OpenCode 收集训练轨迹，但微调后的编码大语言模型在全部四种受测运行框架（C3）下均取得了更高的平均分，包括在 Mini-SWE-Agent 下于 SWE-Bench Verified 上取得了统计学显著的提升（p = 0.002 p=\mathrm{0.002}）。 迁移仍然依赖于具体任务：在从零生成仓库的任务上，性能在两种运行框架下有所提升，但在另外两种下出现下降。 这些发现展示了聚焦于有限能力范围的训练干预的潜力，同时也凸显了在不同任务与运行框架间实现一致迁移所面临的挑战。

paragraphs.en: As coding LLMs increasingly contribute to software development, SE must shape how these models are developed. Debates over agentic and AI-native SE largely focus on how engineers will work with these systems [ 9 , 22 ] . Our industrial case study demonstrates a complementary role: we used established SE knowledge to select engineering capabilities, construct verified training data, and evaluate model improvements. Building RefactorForge also revealed practical challenges, including losses during training-data construction, the constraints verification imposes on capability coverage, and the need to assess improvements and regressions across workloads and agent harnesses. Building on this experience, we call on the SE community to contribute directly to coding LLM training, develop engineering methods for model development and maintenance, and systematically define the capabilities these models should acquire, drawing on established knowledge in SWEBOK [ 57 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 随着编程大语言模型在软件开发中的贡献日益增加，软件工程必须塑造这些模型的开发方式。 关于智能体化与 AI 原生软件工程的争论，主要聚焦于工程师将如何与这些系统协作 [ 9 , 22 ] 。 我们的工业案例研究展示了一种互补性角色：我们利用已有的软件工程知识来选择工程能力、构建经验证的训练数据，并评估模型改进。 构建 RefactorForge 也揭示了一些实际挑战，包括训练数据构建过程中的损失、验证对能力覆盖面的限制，以及需要在不同工作负载和智能体框架下评估改进与退步。 基于这一经验，我们呼吁软件工程社区直接参与编程大语言模型的训练，开发用于模型开发与维护的工程方法，并借鉴 SWEBOK [ 57 ] 中的既有知识，系统地定义这些模型应具备的能力。

paragraphs.en: Industrial setting. The study was conducted at our large international technology company with multiple product lines and heterogeneous software systems that differ in languages, architectures, and development conventions. Our company pretrained a 92B-parameter coding LLM and has refined it through several rounds of post-training. The model now serves more than 100,000 internal developers through different coding agents. Our team maintains and updates this coding LLM, whose capabilities must serve diverse engineering workloads rather than individual products or repositories.

paragraphs.en: Maintaining and updating the coding LLM. The coding LLM evolves through post-training, which combines data targeting different capabilities into a shared training mixture. At this scale, post-training requires substantial computing resources and the allocation of a finite data budget across competing objectives. Full post-training runs therefore follow scheduled cycles rather than being conducted as individual research experiments. Industrial model-development reports describe the same constraint [ 52 , 42 ] . Between cycles, research teams develop candidate training datasets and evaluate their effectiveness through incremental fine-tuning of an existing checkpoint. Before proposing these datasets for inclusion in the next post-training mixture, our team assesses the three challenges introduced in Section I : whether verified training data improves the targeted capability (C1), whether gains transfer to related tasks without unacceptable regressions in other capabilities (C2), and whether improvements persist across agent harnesses (C3). These criteria guide our evaluation in Section IV .
paragraphs.zh: 维护和更新编码大语言模型。 编码大语言模型通过后训练不断演化，后训练将针对不同能力的数据合并为一个共享的训练混合数据集。 在这种规模下，后训练需要大量计算资源，并且需要在相互竞争的目标之间分配有限的数据预算。 因此，完整的后训练运行遵循预定的周期进行，而不是作为单独的研究实验来开展。 工业界的模型开发报告描述了同样的约束 [ 52 , 42 ] 。 在各周期之间，研究团队开发候选训练数据集，并通过对现有检查点进行增量微调来评估其有效性。 在提议将这些数据集纳入下一次后训练混合数据集之前，我们的团队会评估第 I 节中介绍的三个挑战：经过验证的训练数据是否能提升目标能力（C1），收益能否迁移到相关任务而不会在其他能力上出现不可接受的回退（C2），以及改进能否在不同智能体框架之间保持（C3）。 这些标准指导我们在第 IV 节中的评估。

paragraphs.en: Motivation. A recent industrial report described substantial maintainability gains from tool-guided refactoring, achieved through considerable engineering effort. Tornhill [ 54 ] reported increasing the Code Health of a 300,000-line codebase from 5.6 to 10 with CodeScene, which assesses more than 25 maintainability factors on a scale from 1 to 10 [ 11 ] . The effort took three weeks, involved 2,903 commits, approximately US$4,000 in inference costs, an evolving project-specific refactoring playbook, and specialized behavioral verification. In our setting, we cannot build comparable guidance and verification infrastructure for every repository, nor commit such resources to each one. We therefore investigated whether a frontier coding agent could achieve meaningful improvements across repositories with a common refactoring procedure and a fixed budget, without project-specific skills or playbooks.
paragraphs.zh: 研究动机。 最近一份行业报告描述了通过工具引导的重构在投入大量工程 effort 后取得的可维护性显著提升。 Tornhill [54] 报告称，使用 CodeScene 将一个 30 万行代码库的代码健康度（Code Health）从 5.6 提升到了 10，该工具按 1 到 10 的评分评估 25 项以上的可维护性因素 [11]。 这项工作历时三周，包含 2,903 次提交、约 4,000 美元的推理成本、一份不断演进的项目专属重构手册，以及专门的行为验证。 在我们的场景中，我们无法为每个代码库都构建可媲美的引导与验证基础设施，也无法为每个代码库投入如此多的资源。 因此，我们研究了前沿编码智能体能否在采用统一重构流程和固定预算的条件下，在不借助项目专属技能或手册的情况下，跨代码库取得有意义的改进。

sents.en: A recent industrial report described substantial maintainability gains from tool-guided refactoring, achieved through considerable engineering effort.
sents.zh: 最近一份行业报告描述了通过工具引导的重构在投入大量工程 effort 后取得的可维护性显著提升。

sents.en: Tornhill [ 54 ] reported increasing the Code Health of a 300,000-line codebase from 5.6 to 10 with CodeScene, which assesses more than 25 maintainability factors on a scale from 1 to 10 [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: Tornhill [54] 报告称，使用 CodeScene 将一个 30 万行代码库的代码健康度（Code Health）从 5.6 提升到了 10，该工具按 1 到 10 的评分评估 25 项以上的可维护性因素 [11]。

sents.en: The effort took three weeks, involved 2,903 commits, approximately US$4,000 in inference costs, an evolving project-specific refactoring playbook, and specialized behavioral verification.
sents.zh: 这项工作历时三周，包含 2,903 次提交、约 4,000 美元的推理成本、一份不断演进的项目专属重构手册，以及专门的行为验证。

sents.en: In our setting, we cannot build comparable guidance and verification infrastructure for every repository, nor commit such resources to each one.
sents.zh: 在我们的场景中，我们无法为每个代码库都构建可媲美的引导与验证基础设施，也无法为每个代码库投入如此多的资源。

sents.en: We therefore investigated whether a frontier coding agent could achieve meaningful improvements across repositories with a common refactoring procedure and a fixed budget, without project-specific skills or playbooks.
sents.zh: 因此，我们研究了前沿编码智能体能否在采用统一重构流程和固定预算的条件下，在不借助项目专属技能或手册的情况下，跨代码库取得有意义的改进。

paragraphs.en: Approach. We selected five repositories from the DeepSWE long-horizon task set [ 25 ] to evaluate a common procedure across different codebases rather than a single customized environment. We ran Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol at xhigh reasoning effort. Guided by CodeScene feedback, the agent identified refactoring candidates, generated characterization tests when needed, and retained a change only when project tests passed and Code Health improved. The workflow ran autonomously under a budget of US$1,500 until no acceptable change remained or its allocated budget was exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 我们从 DeepSWE 长时程任务集 [ 25 ] 中选取了五个代码库，以在不同代码库上评估一套通用流程，而非单一的定制化环境。 我们以 xhigh 推理力度运行了搭载 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 Codex。 在 CodeScene 反馈的引导下，智能体识别重构候选点，在需要时生成特征化测试，并且仅在项目测试通过且代码健康度（Code Health）得到提升时才保留更改。 该工作流在 1,500 美元的预算下自主运行，直到没有可接受的更改剩余或分配的预算耗尽为止。

paragraphs.en: Results. Three of the five runs exhausted their budgets before completing, despite substantial time and inference expenditure. Together, the runs consumed nearly 99 hours, 2.18 billion tokens, and US$1,500. The unfinished runs improved Code Health by 1.12% to 7.22%, corresponding to absolute gains of 0.10 to 0.50 points on the 10-point scale. Among the two completed runs, Aiomonitor improved by 5.86% (0.48 points). We observed a maximum absolute improvement of 1.76 Code Health points in Dateutil (3.88 to 5.64); although this represented a 45.36% relative gain, its final score remained below the other repositories’ initial scores (Table I ).
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 五次运行中有三次在完成之前耗尽了预算，尽管已经投入了大量的时间和推理开销。 这些运行总共消耗了近99小时、21.8亿个token和1,500美元。 未完成的运行使代码健康度（Code Health）提升了1.12%至7.22%，对应于在10分制上0.10至0.50分的绝对提升。 在两次已完成的运行中，Aiomonitor提升了5.86%（0.48分）。 我们观察到Dateutil的最大绝对提升为1.76个代码健康度分（3.88至5.64）；尽管这代表了45.36%的相对提升，但其最终得分仍低于其他代码库的初始得分（表I）。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that tool-guided refactoring alone may yield limited improvements under our industrial constraints. Despite substantial agent effort, maintainability improvements were modest and uneven. Our shared coding LLM serves developers across heterogeneous repositories, where we cannot rely on open-ended agent budgets or repository-specific refactoring playbooks. Together with the uneven refactoring performance in Figure 1 , these observations motivated us to investigate whether SE knowledge could strengthen the coding LLM’s underlying refactoring capability through training. Section III presents RefactorForge, which constructs the verified training data needed to improve this capability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，在本文的工业约束条件下，仅依靠工具引导的重构可能收效有限。 尽管智能体投入了大量精力，可维护性的提升仍然有限且不均衡。 我们共享的编码大语言模型服务于异构代码库中的开发者，我们无法依赖无上限的智能体预算或针对特定代码库的重构手册。 结合图 1 中不均衡的重构表现，这些观察促使我们研究能否通过训练来增强编码大语言模型的底层重构能力，即引入软件工程（SE）知识。 第三节介绍 RefactorForge，它构建了提升该能力所需的经过验证的训练数据。

sents.en: Section III presents RefactorForge, which constructs the verified training data needed to improve this capability.
sents.zh: 第三节介绍 RefactorForge，它构建了提升该能力所需的经过验证的训练数据。

paragraphs.en: We constructed RefactorForge to leverage established SE knowledge to generate verified training data for improving the refactoring capability of our coding LLM. RefactorForge first constructs executable tasks from controlled refactoring transformations in real repositories. Each task has a known objective and independently verifiable outcome. A teacher coding agent then attempts each task without access to its reference patch or hidden grading tests. We retain trajectories only whose final solutions pass the specified checks. Each retained trajectory records the task instruction, tool calls, repository observations, and code edits. We then use these successful trajectories to train our coding LLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), as described in Section IV-A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 RefactorForge，利用已有的软件工程知识来生成经过验证的训练数据，以提升我们的代码大语言模型的重构能力。 RefactorForge 首先从真实仓库中受控的重构变换构建可执行任务。 每个任务都有已知的目标和可独立验证的结果。 然后由一个教师编码智能体在不接触参考补丁或隐藏评分测试的情况下尝试每个任务。 我们只保留最终解决方案通过指定检查的轨迹。 每条保留的轨迹记录了任务指令、工具调用、仓库观察结果和代码编辑。 随后，我们使用这些成功的轨迹通过监督微调（SFT）来训练我们的代码大语言模型，如第 IV-A 节所述。

paragraphs.en: We drew on SE knowledge to guide how RefactorForge constructs and verifies tasks. Specifically, we used refactoring preconditions to identify eligible code, established engineering tools to construct reference transformations, and structural and behavioral checks to define acceptable solutions. Following the executable-task format established by SWE-Bench [ 27 ] , RefactorForge uses fail-to-pass (F2P) tests that fail before the transformation and pass afterward, and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests that remain passing in both states. Figure 2 summarizes the twelve-step pipeline across four phases. We first explain how we selected refactoring types, then present the state of practice, SE-informed decision, and implementation for each phase.
paragraphs.zh: 我们借鉴软件工程（SE）知识来指导 RefactorForge 如何构建和验证任务。 具体而言，我们利用重构前置条件来识别符合条件的代码，借助成熟的工程工具来构建参考转换，并通过结构检查和行为检查来定义可接受的解决方案。 遵循 SWE-Bench [ 27 ] 确立的可执行任务格式，RefactorForge 使用“由失败转为通过”（F2P）测试（在转换前失败、在转换后通过）以及“保持通过”（P2P）测试（在转换前后均保持通过）。 图 2 概括了跨四个阶段的十二步流程。 我们首先说明如何选择重构类型，然后针对每个阶段依次介绍当前实践现状、基于软件工程（SE）的决策以及具体实现。

paragraphs.en: State of Practice. Existing coding-model training pipelines use several approaches to task construction. SWE-Gym and SWE-smith derive tasks from repository issues or synthetic faults [ 37 , 64 ] , while SWE-Flow uses test-driven development to construct incremental training tasks [ 69 ] . Refactoring-specific training focuses on individual operations: Palit and Sharma [ 36 ] train models for Java Extract Method, and RefBERT studies variable-name recommendations [ 31 ] . Our pipeline requires executable repository-level tasks across several refactoring types, including operations that coordinate changes to definitions and references across files.
paragraphs.zh: 实践现状。 现有的代码模型训练流水线使用多种方法来构建任务。 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-smith 从代码仓库问题或合成故障中导出任务 [ 37 , 64 ]，而 SWE-Flow 使用测试驱动开发来构建增量式训练任务 [ 69 ]。 针对重构的专项训练聚焦于单个操作：Palit 和 Sharma [ 36 ] 训练模型执行 Java 的提取方法操作，RefBERT 则研究变量名推荐 [ 31 ]。 我们的流水线需要可执行的、跨多种重构类型的代码仓库级任务，包括那些协调跨文件的定义与引用更改的操作。

paragraphs.en: SE-Informed Decision. We selected the Rename, Move, and Remove families based on empirical evidence about refactoring practices and coding-model limitations. Murphy-Hill et al. [ 33 ] found that developers frequently rename program elements and perform move refactorings. Caivano et al. [ 8 ] documented persistent unused methods, while Ebrahimi et al. [ 15 ] found that coding LLMs can avoid deleting code even when the intended change requires removal. These operations provide explicit training targets while requiring agents to locate definitions, trace dependencies, and coordinate changes across files.

paragraphs.en: State of Practice. Constructing executable repository environments remains a bottleneck in coding-agent training [ 64 ] . Existing pipelines use LLM agents to identify dependencies and resolve installation failures. SWE-smith combines agent-assisted environment discovery with manual review [ 64 ] , while SWE-rebench uses execution feedback to refine model-generated installation recipes [ 6 ] . Scale-SWE, SWE-Factory, and daVinci-Env use agents for the construction of the environment [ 70 , 20 , 17 ] . Although these approaches reduce manual configuration effort, they incur inference costs without guaranteeing successful environment construction [ 20 ] . These costs can become substantial at scale [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 实践现状。 构建可执行的仓库环境仍然是智能体编程训练中的瓶颈 [ 64 ] 。 现有流程使用大语言模型智能体来识别依赖并解决安装失败问题。 SWE-smith 将智能体辅助的环境发现与人工审查相结合 [ 64 ] ，而 SWE-rebench 利用执行反馈来改进模型生成的安装方案 [ 6 ] 。 Scale-SWE、SWE-Factory 和 daVinci-Env 使用智能体进行环境构建 [ 70 , 20 , 17 ] 。 尽管这些方法减少了人工配置的工作量，但它们会产生推理成本，且无法保证环境构建成功 [ 20 ] 。 在大规模场景下，这些成本可能变得相当可观 [ 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: SE-Informed Decision. We approached environment preparation as a problem of reproducible builds and regression testing. We designed RefactorForge to derive installation recipes from package metadata, apply explicit repair rules, and reserve bounded LLM assistance only for unresolved failures. We accept an environment only after it passes validation and its frozen recipe was successfully replayed. However, these requirements restrict the pool of repositories available for training-task construction, as repositories without reproducible environments are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 基于软件工程信息的决策。 我们将环境准备工作视为可复现构建与回归测试问题来解决。 我们将 RefactorForge 设计为从包元数据推导安装配方、应用显式修复规则，并仅为未解决的失败保留有边界的 LLM 辅助。 只有当环境通过验证且其冻结配方被成功重放后，我们才接受该环境。 然而，这些要求限制了可用于构建训练任务的仓库范围，因为无法复现环境的仓库会被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: We selected actively maintained packages from the Python Package Index (PyPI) because its structured release, dependency, and installation metadata supports automated environment construction and reproducible project-version selection. For each package, RefactorForge identifies the upstream repository, maps the release to a tag, and records the corresponding commit hash to fix the project version.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Python 包索引（PyPI）中选择持续活跃维护的软件包，因为其结构化的发布、依赖与安装元数据支持自动化环境构建和可复现的项目版本选择。 对于每个软件包，RefactorForge 会识别其上游仓库，将发布版本映射到对应的标签，并记录相应的提交哈希以固定项目版本。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge extracts compatible Python versions and build and test dependencies from package metadata, optional dependency groups, requirements files, and tox configurations. It uses these to generate Dockerfiles, then attempts project installation, test collection, and test execution before requesting LLM assistance.
paragraphs.zh: RefactorForge 从包元数据、可选依赖组、requirements 文件和 tox 配置中提取兼容的 Python 版本以及构建和测试依赖。 它使用这些信息生成 Dockerfile，然后在请求 LLM 协助之前，先尝试项目安装、测试收集和测试执行。

sents.en: It uses these to generate Dockerfiles, then attempts project installation, test collection, and test execution before requesting LLM assistance.
sents.zh: 它使用这些信息生成 Dockerfile，然后在请求 LLM 协助之前，先尝试项目安装、测试收集和测试执行。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge first applies deterministic repairs and cached solutions to address known installation failures, unsupported pytest options and markers, missing imports, and dependency incompatibilities. If these fail, RefactorForge queries GLM 5.3 to propose structured repairs to dependencies, Python versions, or environment variables. The model cannot execute shell commands, modify project code, or change test commands. RefactorForge applies and validates each proposal and caches successful repairs for reuse. Each project receives at most six build-and-test-collection attempts, two additional rounds of dependency repair, and seven LLM repair requests. Projects with unresolved failures are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: RefactorForge 首先应用确定性修复和缓存解决方案，以处理已知的安装失败、不支持的 pytest 选项和标记、缺失的导入以及依赖不兼容问题。 如果这些方法失败，RefactorForge 会查询 GLM 5.3，以提出针对依赖、Python 版本或环境变量的结构化修复方案。 该模型无法执行 shell 命令、修改项目代码或更改测试命令。 RefactorForge 会应用并验证每个提议，并缓存成功的修复方案以供复用。 每个项目最多获得六次构建与测试收集尝试、两轮额外的依赖修复以及七次 LLM 修复请求。 存在未解决失败的项目将被拒绝。

sents.zh: 存在未解决失败的项目将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge accepts an environment only when the project installation succeeds, test collection completes without errors, and two testing conditions hold: the project has at least one passing test, and no tests fail or produce errors. Skipped tests and expected failures are permitted but do not count as passing tests. RefactorForge records the passing tests and baseline execution time, freezes the recipe, and verifies reproducibility through replay. These passing tests form the P2P regression suite used in later phases.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当项目安装成功、测试收集完成且无错误，并且满足两个测试条件——项目至少有一个通过的测试，且没有测试失败或产生错误——时，RefactorForge 才接受该环境。 跳过的测试和预期失败是允许的，但不计为通过的测试。 RefactorForge 记录通过的测试和基准执行时间，冻结配方，并通过重放验证可复现性。 这些通过的测试构成后续阶段使用的 P2P 回归测试套件。

paragraphs.zh: 我们利用成熟的软件工程工具、重构前提条件以及转换语义，构建了可独立验证的参考补丁。 阶段一建立了可供模型进行练习的可复现仓库，而阶段二则确定它们应当学习哪些转换。

paragraphs.en: State of Practice. Prior work combines LLMs with SE tools to support refactoring execution. EM-Assist separates candidate generation, static analysis, and transformation, using an LLM, program analysis, and an IDE, respectively [ 41 ] . MANTRA instead uses collaborating agents to generate and repair refactored code [ 61 ] , while RefactoringMirror uses IntelliJ IDEA to reapply transformations detected in LLM-generated revisions [ 30 ] . Although these approaches support refactoring execution, constructing training data also requires reference transformations with independently checkable correctness criteria. Obtaining such transformations presents two challenges. First, mining repository histories requires separating refactorings from accompanying changes, as SWE-Refactor demonstrates [ 62 ] . Second, generating refactorings with LLMs can produce unsafe transformations that available unit tests fail to detect, as Liu et al. found [ 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 实践现状。 已有工作将大语言模型与软件工程工具结合，以支持重构执行。 EM-Assist 将候选生成、静态分析和转换三者分离，分别使用大语言模型、程序分析和 IDE [ 41 ] 。 MANTRA 则使用协作的智能体来生成和修复重构后的代码 [ 61 ] ，而 RefactoringMirror 使用 IntelliJ IDEA 重新应用在大语言模型生成的修订中检测到的转换 [ 30 ] 。 尽管这些方法支持重构执行，构建训练数据还需要具有可独立检验正确性标准的参考转换。 获取此类转换面临两个挑战。 首先，挖掘仓库历史需要将重构与伴随的变更分离开来，正如 SWE-Refactor 所展示的 [ 62 ] 。 其次，使用大语言模型生成重构可能产生不安全的转换，而现有单元测试无法检测到这些问题，正如 Liu 等人发现的 [ 30 ] 。

paragraphs.en: SE-Informed Decision. We chose to generate reference patches using refactoring semantics rather than unconstrained LLM-generated changes. We defined eligibility conditions and structural transformation procedures for each refactoring type. RefactorForge uses program analysis to identify eligible symbols and PyCharm or Ruff to apply the specified transformations. We restricted LLM assistance to bounded parameters, such as alternative identifiers, rather than code changes. This approach avoids dependence on mined developer patches but limits coverage to transformations supported by the selected tools and checks.
paragraphs.zh: 基于软件工程信息的决策。 我们选择使用重构语义来生成参考补丁，而不是无约束的大语言模型生成变更。 我们为每种重构类型定义了适用条件和结构化转换过程。 RefactorForge 使用程序分析来识别符合条件的符号，并使用 PyCharm 或 Ruff 应用指定的转换。 我们将大语言模型的辅助限制在有界参数上，例如备选标识符，而不是代码变更。 这种方法避免了对挖掘的开发者补丁的依赖，但将覆盖范围限制在所选工具和检查所支持的转换上。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge uses PyCharm’s program-analysis APIs to identify definitions, resolve repository-wide usages, and evaluate type-specific eligibility conditions. For example, Remove Unused Function targets private, undecorated top-level functions with no resolved usages. For Remove Unused Import , RefactorForge uses Ruff’s unused-import diagnostics, restricted to from ... import ... statements. For each eligible candidate, RefactorForge records its source location, current name, and relevant usage metadata.
paragraphs.zh: RefactorForge 利用 PyCharm 的程序分析 API 来识别定义、解析整个仓库范围内的使用情况，并评估特定类型的适用条件。 例如，Remove Unused Function（移除未使用函数）针对的是没有解析到任何使用情况的私有、无装饰器的顶层函数。 对于 Remove Unused Import（移除未使用导入），RefactorForge 使用 Ruff 的未使用导入诊断，且仅限于 from ... import ... 语句。 对于每个符合条件的候选对象，RefactorForge 会记录其源码位置、当前名称以及相关的使用元数据。

sents.en: For example, Remove Unused Function targets private, undecorated top-level functions with no resolved usages.
sents.zh: 例如，Remove Unused Function（移除未使用函数）针对的是没有解析到任何使用情况的私有、无装饰器的顶层函数。

sents.en: For Remove Unused Import , RefactorForge uses Ruff’s unused-import diagnostics, restricted to from ... import ... statements.
sents.zh: 对于 Remove Unused Import（移除未使用导入），RefactorForge 使用 Ruff 的未使用导入诊断，且仅限于 from ... import ... 语句。

sents.en: For each eligible candidate, RefactorForge records its source location, current name, and relevant usage metadata.
sents.zh: 对于每个符合条件的候选对象，RefactorForge 会记录其源码位置、当前名称以及相关的使用元数据。

paragraphs.en: For rename operations, we require plausible alternative identifiers that RefactorForge could validate without allowing an LLM to modify code. RefactorForge uses GLM 5.3 to propose a different, meaning-preserving identifier from the symbol’s name, type, file path, and surrounding code. Deterministic filters reject unchanged names, invalid identifiers, Python keywords, and changes to the original leading-underscore category. These filters also enforce PEP 8 naming conventions: snake_case for functions and attributes, CapWords for classes, and UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for constants.
paragraphs.zh: 对于重命名操作，我们要求提供合理的备选标识符，供 RefactorForge 在不允许大语言模型修改代码的前提下进行验证。 RefactorForge 使用 GLM 5.3，根据符号的名称、类型、文件路径及周围代码，提出一个不同的、保持语义的标识符。 确定性过滤器会拒绝未变化的名称、无效的标识符、Python 关键字，以及改变原有下划线前缀类别的修改。 这些过滤器还强制执行 PEP 8 命名规范：函数和属性使用 snake_case，类使用 CapWords，常量使用 UPPER_SNAKE_CASE。

paragraphs.en: For Move Function , RefactorForge identifies plausible destinations from the distribution of resolved function usages, favoring modules that already depend on the function. It counts usages by repository module, excluding import statements, and selects the module outside the source module with the highest count. The destination must contain at least two usages and more usages than the source module. RefactorForge breaks ties by lexicographic file-path order and rejects destinations containing a conflicting definition or an import binding the same name to a different symbol. However, RefactorForge permits existing imports of the function being moved. This heuristic identifies a plausible training destination, not necessarily the architecturally optimal one. Remove operations require no additional parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 对于移动函数（Move Function），RefactorForge 根据已解析函数调用的分布识别合理的目标位置，优先选择已经依赖该函数的模块。 它按仓库模块统计调用次数（排除 import 语句），并选择源模块之外调用次数最高的模块。 目标模块必须至少包含两次调用，且调用次数多于源模块。 当出现并列时，RefactorForge 按文件路径的字典序打破平局，并拒绝包含冲突定义、或存在将同一名称绑定到不同符号的 import 的目标模块。 不过，RefactorForge 允许目标模块中已存在对被移动函数的 import。 这种启发式方法识别的是一个合理的训练目标位置，而不一定是架构上最优的位置。 移除（Remove）操作不需要额外参数。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge uses PyCharm’s program-structure and refactoring APIs to apply supported rename and move transformations, and Ruff’s diagnostic fixes to remove unused imports. These tools construct patches without LLM-generated code changes. For each candidate, RefactorForge applies the transformation to the project version pinned in Step III-B , records the patch and refactoring metadata, and restores the original repository before processing the next candidate.

paragraphs.en: Although each transformation has a bounded objective, its patch can require coordinated changes across files. Across 5,704 generated tasks, the median patch changes two files, spans four diff hunks, and involves eight lines of patch churn (lines added plus deleted). At the 95th percentile, patches change six files, span 17 hunks, and involve 56 lines of churn.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管每个转换的目标是有界的，但其补丁可能需要跨文件进行协调一致的修改。 在 5,704 个生成的任务中，补丁的中位数修改两个文件，跨越四个 diff 块，并涉及八行的补丁变动（新增行加删除行）。 在第 95 百分位处，补丁修改六个文件，跨越 17 个块，并涉及 56 行变动。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge validates each reference patch by applying it to the original repository and executing syntax and operation-specific structural checks. For renames, it checks naming conventions and incomplete reference updates. For Move Function , it verifies that the definition appears at the destination, disappears from the source, leaves unrelated top-level definitions unchanged, and introduces no duplicate imports. RefactorForge then reruns every project test that passed in Phase I and accepts the patch only if all structural checks pass and previously passing tests remain passing.
paragraphs.zh: RefactorForge 通过将每个参考补丁应用到原始仓库，并执行语法和特定于操作的结构检查来验证它。 对于重命名，它检查命名规范和不完整的引用更新。 对于「移动函数」，它验证定义出现在目标位置、从源位置消失、不改变无关的顶层定义，并且不引入重复的导入。 RefactorForge 随后重新运行在阶段 I 中通过的所有项目测试，仅当所有结构检查通过且之前通过的测试仍然通过时才接受该补丁。

paragraphs.en: We thus obtained reference patches that passed the implemented structural checks and the project tests that had passed before the transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们由此获得了通过了已实现的结构检查以及在转换之前就已通过的项目测试的参考补丁。

paragraphs.en: A validated reference patch specifies what the model should change, but does not establish how to assess an agent’s solution. In Phase III, RefactorForge converts each reference transformation into an executable instruction with independently verifiable correctness criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 经过验证的参考补丁指明了模型应当修改什么，但并未确立如何评估智能体的解决方案。 在第三阶段中，RefactorForge 将每个参考转换转化为一条可执行的指令，并带有可独立验证的正确性标准。

paragraphs.en: State of Practice. Coding-agent benchmarks commonly use executable F2P and P2P tests. Pipelines such as SWE-smith and R2E-Gym construct tasks from synthetic faults or development histories [ 64 , 26 ] . For refactoring, however, passing project tests does not establish that the requested transformation occurred. Hong et al. [ 23 ] demonstrate this distinction in SWE Refactor Bench. Across 520 migration runs, 30 preserved tested behavior but failed the migration audit, while 252 satisfied the audit but failed behavioral tests. SWE-Refactor, RefactorBench, and CodeTaste also combine structural checks with behavioral validation [ 62 , 18 , 53 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 实践现状。 编码智能体基准通常使用可执行的 F2P 与 P2P 测试。 SWE-smith 和 R2E-Gym 等流水线从合成故障或开发历史中构建任务 [ 64 , 26 ] 。 然而，对于重构而言，通过项目测试并不能证明所请求的转换确实发生了。Hong 等人 [ 23 ] 在 SWE Refactor Bench 中展示了这一区别。 在 520 次迁移运行中，30 次保留了经过测试的行为但未通过迁移审计，而 252 次满足了审计但未通过行为测试。 SWE-Refactor、RefactorBench 和 CodeTaste 也将结构检查与行为验证相结合 [ 62 , 18 , 53 ] 。

paragraphs.en: SE-Informed Decision. We used refactoring-specific correctness obligations to construct training tasks. RefactorForge generates instructions that specify the intended operation without revealing its implementation, requiring agents to locate and modify the relevant code. To verify the resulting changes, RefactorForge derives structural F2P tests from the reference transformation and reuses previously passing project tests for regression checking.

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge provides GLM 5.3 with the refactoring type, symbol metadata, and validated reference patch to generate a task instruction. Following RefactorBench’s Lazy instruction style, the model produces a brief developer-facing request that identifies the required symbols but omits file paths and patch contents. RefactorForge checks the instruction against the recorded metadata. Instructions containing unsupported details, file paths, or raw patch syntax are rejected, and a revision is requested.
paragraphs.zh: RefactorForge 向 GLM 5.3 提供重构类型、符号元数据以及经过验证的参考补丁，以生成任务指令。 按照 RefactorBench 的 Lazy 指令风格，模型会生成一份简短的面向开发者的请求，其中指明所需的符号，但省略文件路径和补丁内容。 RefactorForge 将该指令与记录的元数据进行核对。 包含不受支持的细节、文件路径或原始补丁语法的指令将被拒绝，并要求进行修订。

paragraphs.en: We selected GLM 5.3 as the teacher model to generate solutions and execution trajectories for the refactoring tasks. Its publicly available weights support self-hosted inference, and its reported 95.4% SWE-Bench Verified score under Mini-SWE-Agent demonstrates substantial repository-level coding capability [ 55 ] . For each executable task, RefactorForge runs GLM 5.3 through the OpenCode [ 2 ] coding-agent harness. The teacher receives the task instruction and original repository but neither the reference solution nor the hidden grading tests. RefactorForge checks the teacher’s final solution against both F2P and P2P tests and retains the trajectory only if it passes both. Of 5,704 tasks, 4,889 (85.71%) yielded successful teacher trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择 GLM 5.3 作为教师模型，为重构任务生成解答与执行轨迹。 其公开权重支持自托管推理，其在 Mini-SWE-Agent 下报告的 95.4% SWE-Bench Verified 分数展现了出色的仓库级编码能力 [ 55 ] 。 对于每个可执行任务，RefactorForge 通过 OpenCode [ 2 ] 编码智能体框架运行 GLM 5.3。 教师模型接收任务指令和原始仓库，但既不接收参考解答，也不接收隐藏的评分测试。 RefactorForge 用 F2P 和 P2P 测试来检验教师模型的最终解答，仅当其同时通过两者时才保留该轨迹。 在 5,704 个任务中，4,889 个（85.71%）成功产出了教师模型轨迹。

paragraphs.en: RefactorForge further filters successful trajectories for malformed conversations, incomplete responses, excessive repetition, garbled text, restricted terms, non-English characters, and invalid multi-turn structure. Unlike the F2P and P2P checks, these filters assess the trajectory rather than the final code. After filtering, 4,572 trajectories remained for student training.

paragraphs.en: Training. Our baseline, Baseline-92B 1 1 1 Anonymized for double blind , was our company’s 92B-parameter coding LLM (Section II-A ), post-trained from a pre-trained model using a mixture spanning multiple capabilities. While we cannot disclose the full mixture, its code-related portion comprised 938,180 trajectories and 15.66 billion tokens. As discussed in Section II-A , we used incremental supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to evaluate the effectiveness of new training data between scheduled full post-training cycles. We fine-tuned Baseline-92B on 4,572 verified RefactorForge trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens (0.46% of the preceding code-related allocation), producing Refact-92B . These trajectories averaged 11.77 agent turns and covered seven refactoring types across the Rename, Move, and Remove families. Training ran for 6 epochs and 83 iterations on 12 nodes, with a batch size of 48 sequences and a maximum sequence length of 128K tokens (full settings in the supplementary material [ 3 ] ).
paragraphs.zh: 训练。 我们的基线 Baseline-92B（1 1 1 为双盲评审已匿名化）是我们公司的 920 亿参数代码大语言模型（见第 II-A 节），从一个预训练模型出发，使用涵盖多种能力的混合数据进行了后训练。 虽然我们无法公开完整的混合数据构成，但其代码相关部分包含 938,180 条轨迹和 156.6 亿个 token。 如第 II-A 节所述，我们使用增量监督微调（SFT）来评估新训练数据在两个预定的完整后训练周期之间的有效性。 我们在 4,572 条经过验证的 RefactorForge 轨迹上对 Baseline-92B 进行微调，共计 7,251 万个 token（占此前代码相关数据配额的 0.46%），得到 Refact-92B。 这些轨迹平均包含 11.77 个智能体回合，覆盖了重命名、移动和删除三个系列下的七种重构类型。 训练在 12 个节点上运行了 6 个 epoch 和 83 次迭代，批大小为 48 个序列，最大序列长度为 128K 个 token（完整设置见补充材料 [3]）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We designed our evaluation around the three challenges identified in Section II-A . For each benchmark, we report Avg. @3, the average score across three independent runs per model, and the difference between models in percentage points (pp). We also compare each model’s highest-scoring run using a one-sided exact McNemar test [ 32 ] . Because both models attempt the same tasks, McNemar tests differences in paired binary outcomes rather than treating success rates as independent. We report matched-pair odds ratios (OR), where OR greater than 1 favors Refact-92B .
paragraphs.zh: 评估。 我们围绕第 II-A 节中确定的三个挑战设计了评估。 对于每个基准测试，我们报告 Avg. @3（即每个模型在三次独立运行中的平均得分）以及模型之间以百分点（pp）表示的差异。 我们还使用单侧精确 McNemar 检验 [32] 比较每个模型得分最高的一次运行。 由于两个模型尝试相同的任务，McNemar 检验比较的是配对二元结果之间的差异，而不是将成功率视为相互独立的。 我们报告配对优势比（OR），当 OR 大于 1 时表示 Refact-92B 占优。

paragraphs.en: C1: Improving refactoring capability. We evaluated targeted refactoring using two benchmarks: RefactorBench [ 18 ] (Lazy set) and SWE-Bench ProMax [ 45 ] . The Lazy set contains 100 Python tasks with brief instructions that require agents to infer the necessary repository changes, while ProMax contains 170 refactoring tasks across seven languages. We used OpenCode [ 2 ] for both benchmarks, matching the harness used to collect teacher trajectories.

paragraphs.en: C2: Transfer to other engineering tasks. We evaluated transfer beyond targeted refactoring using three benchmarks: SWE-Bench Verified [ 34 ] , SWE-Bench Pro [ 12 ] , and NL2Repo-Bench [ 13 ] . The first two assess issue resolution. SWE-Bench Verified contains 500 human-screened Python issues, while SWE-Bench Pro’s public v1 set contains 731 bug-fixing and feature-implementation tasks across four languages. SWE-Bench Pro is significantly more challenging and requires long-horizon reasoning. NL2Repo-Bench assesses repository generation, requiring agents to construct a complete, installable Python repository, including its architecture, dependencies, and implementation, from a natural-language requirements document and an empty workspace.
paragraphs.zh: C2：迁移到其他工程任务。 我们使用三个基准评估了超越目标重构的迁移能力：SWE-Bench Verified [ 34 ]、SWE-Bench Pro [ 12 ] 和 NL2Repo-Bench [ 13 ]。 前两个基准评估问题解决能力。 SWE-Bench Verified 包含 500 个人工筛选的 Python 问题，而 SWE-Bench Pro 的公开 v1 数据集包含跨四种语言的 731 个缺陷修复和功能实现任务。 SWE-Bench Pro 具有显著更高的挑战性，并需要长程推理。 NL2Repo-Bench 评估仓库生成，要求智能体根据一份自然语言需求文档和一个空工作区，构建一个完整、可安装的 Python 仓库，包括其架构、依赖和实现。

paragraphs.en: C1: Fine-tuning on verified refactoring trajectories improves refactoring performance.
paragraphs.zh: C1：在经验证的重构轨迹上进行微调可提升重构性能。

paragraphs.en: Refact-92B outperforms Baseline-92B by 18.00 percentage points (pp) on RefactorBench and 7.06 pp on SWE-Bench ProMax. Success rates increased from 43.00% to 61.00% on RefactorBench, and from 51.18% to 58.24% on ProMax (Table III ). The ProMax improvement is notable because the benchmark evaluates large-scale refactoring across seven programming languages, with tasks modifying 11.4 files on average, whereas our training data came exclusively from Python repositories.

paragraphs.en: Refact-92B outperforms Baseline-92B in seven of thirteen refactoring categories and successfully completed tasks in eleven, despite training on only seven refactoring types. Refact-92B’s overall success rate of 61% approached GPT-5.2’s 62% and exceeded GLM-5.1’s 51% in our motivating evaluation (Figure 1). Refact-92B also succeeded in 11 of 13 categories, compared with 10 for GPT-5.2 and 12 for GLM-5.1. These results show how a bounded, capability-focused training intervention can strengthen performance across refactoring operations beyond those explicitly trained.
paragraphs.zh: Refact-92B 在十三个重构类别中的七个上优于 Baseline-92B，并且在十一个类别中成功完成了任务，尽管其仅在七种重构类型上进行了训练。 重命名占我们训练任务的 96.4%，但性能提升延伸到了其他操作。 例如，「引入参数对象」的成功率从 0% 提高到 75.0%（图 3）。 成功率低于 50% 的类别数量也从七个减少到五个，形成了更加均衡的性能表现。 在我们的动机评估中，Refact-92B 的整体成功率为 61%，接近 GPT-5.2 的 62%，并超过了 GLM-5.1 的 51%（图 1）。 Refact-92B 还在 13 个类别中的 11 个取得了成功，相比之下 GPT-5.2 为 10 个，GLM-5.1 为 12 个。 这些结果表明，一种有边界的、聚焦能力取向的训练干预可以提升超出显式训练范围之外的重构操作的性能。

paragraphs.en: C2: Performance gains extend beyond refactoring to other SE tasks.
paragraphs.zh: C2：性能提升不仅限于重构，还扩展到其他软件工程（SE）任务。

paragraphs.en: Refact-92B outperforms Baseline-92B by 4.97 pp on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.2 pp on SWE-Bench Pro, extending gains beyond the refactoring tasks used for training. Under OpenCode, SWE-Bench Verified increased from 62.00% to 66.97%, while SWE-Bench Pro increased from 48.97% to 50.20% (Table III ). SWE-Bench Pro is demanding, evaluating long-horizon bug fixing and feature implementation across four programming languages. paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the lessons learned from developing RefactorForge to construct capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects on a coding LLM designed to support diverse workloads at industrial scale.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍开发 RefactorForge 的经验教训，包括构建以能力为核心的训练数据，以及评估其对一个旨在支持工业规模多样化工作负载的代码 LLM 所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: L1. Account for losses at each stage of training-data construction. Generating executable tasks does not guarantee usable training data. Of the 729 projects we assessed, 614 built successfully, but only 306 (42.0%) satisfied our environment acceptance criteria. These environments yielded 5,704 executable tasks, of which the teacher agent successfully solved 4,889. Subsequent trajectory-quality filtering left 4,572 trajectories for training. Each stage imposes distinct requirements, from reproducible environments and correct solutions to suitable trajectories for training. Teams must account for these reductions when planning training-data generation and allocating resources.
paragraphs.zh: L1。 需考虑训练数据构建各阶段的损失。 生成可执行任务并不能保证获得可用的训练数据。 在我们评估的 729 个项目中，614 个构建成功，但只有 306 个（42.0%）满足我们的环境验收标准。 这些环境产生了 5,704 个可执行任务，其中教师智能体成功解决了 4,889 个。 随后的轨迹质量过滤留下了 4,572 条用于训练的轨迹。 每个阶段都有不同的要求，从可复现的环境和正确的解法，到适合训练的轨迹。 团队在规划训练数据生成和分配资源时，必须将这些损耗考虑在内。

sents.zh: 需考虑训练数据构建各阶段的损失。

paragraphs.en: L2. Plan capability coverage together with verification. The refactoring operations RefactorForge could include in training depended on its ability to construct and verify their transformations. We selected seven refactoring types based on established practices [ 33 ] . For instance, renames accounted for 96.4% of generated tasks (Table II ). This concentration also reflects their verifiability: PyCharm can identify eligible symbols and update affected references, while structural and regression tests can check whether the requested transformation occurred and previously passing tests remain passing. As SWE Refactor Bench demonstrates, verifying that a transformation occurred and that it preserved behavior requires distinct checks [ 62 ] . The availability of such checks therefore shapes which engineering capabilities we can reliably train our models on.
paragraphs.zh: L2。 将能力覆盖与验证一起规划。 RefactorForge 可以纳入训练的重构操作，取决于其构造并验证这些变换的能力。 我们基于已有的成熟实践选择了七种重构类型 [ 33 ] 。 例如，重命名占生成任务的 96.4%（表 II ）。 这种集中也反映了它们的可验证性：PyCharm 可以识别符合条件的符号并更新受影响的引用，而结构测试和回归测试可以检查所请求的变换是否发生、以及原本通过的测试是否仍然通过。 正如 SWE Refactor Bench 所展示的，验证变换是否发生以及验证它是否保持了行为，需要不同的检查 [ 62 ] 。 因此，这类检查的可用性决定了我们能够在哪些工程能力上可靠地训练我们的模型。

sents.en: Plan capability coverage together with verification.
sents.zh: 将能力覆盖与验证一起规划。

sents.en: The refactoring operations RefactorForge could include in training depended on its ability to construct and verify their transformations.

sents.en: We selected seven refactoring types based on established practices [ 33 ] .

sents.en: This concentration also reflects their verifiability: PyCharm can identify eligible symbols and update affected references, while structural and regression tests can check whether the requested transformation occurred and previously passing tests remain passing.

sents.en: The availability of such checks therefore shapes which engineering capabilities we can reliably train our models on.

paragraphs.en: Extract Class illustrates this challenge. Neither Baseline-92B nor Refact-92B solved the Extract Class tasks in RefactorBench (Figure 3 ). Expanding capability coverage therefore requires not only additional task generators but also verification methods that capture more complex engineering objectives. important role for SE research.

paragraphs.en: L3. Evaluate capability improvements against regression gates. Post-training an existing coding LLM requires the same regression-testing discipline as maintaining conventional software [ 42 ] . Refact-92B improved refactoring and related SWE issue-resolution performance but regressed on greenfield repository generation under two of four harnesses. Refactoring and issue resolution share operations such as locating code, tracing dependencies, and preserving behavior, whereas greenfield generation requires additional capabilities our training data does not explicitly target. Our incremental fine-tuning experiment revealed these trade-offs before integration into the full post-training mixture, highlighting the importance of regression gates when evaluating model updates.
paragraphs.zh: L3。 对照回归门禁评估能力改进。 对现有代码大模型进行后训练，需要与维护传统软件相同的回归测试纪律 [ 42 ] 。 Refact-92B 在重构及相关的软件工程问题解决方面表现提升，但在四个测试框架中的两个上，全新仓库生成出现了退化。 重构与问题解决共享定位代码、追踪依赖和保持行为等操作，而全新仓库生成则需要我们的训练数据未明确针对的额外能力。 我们的增量微调实验在集成到完整后训练混合数据之前揭示了这些权衡，凸显了评估模型更新时回归门禁的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in coding LLMs have intensified questions about the future of SE research. Salsabil et al. [ 44 ] revisited 35 LLM-based techniques from ICSE 2026 and found that a newer model using a single prompt outperformed 13, with mixed results for another nine. Importantly, techniques providing domain-specific knowledge and external feedback proved more resilient, highlighting the enduring value of engineering expertise. Meanwhile, ongoing discussions question how increasingly capable coding agents will reshape software development and whether the roles of developers and SE expertise will diminish [ 9 , 22 , 58 , 67 , 7 ] . We see a different opportunity. Our experience demonstrates how SE knowledge can directly improve the coding LLMs driving these changes. Rather than diminishing, we argue that our field’s role must expand to developing these models themselves. We propose three calls to action for SE research.
paragraphs.zh: 编程大语言模型的最新进展加剧了关于软件工程（SE）研究未来的疑问。Salsabil 等人 [44] 重新评估了 ICSE 2026 中 35 项基于大语言模型的技术，发现使用单一提示词的较新模型超越了其中 13 项，另有 9 项结果好坏参半。 重要的是，提供领域特定知识和外部反馈的技术被证明更具韧性，凸显了工程专业知识的持久价值。 与此同时，持续的讨论提出质疑：日益强大的编程智能体将如何重塑软件开发，开发者角色和软件工程专业知识是否会被削弱 [9, 22, 58, 67, 7]。 我们看到了一个不同的机遇。 我们的经验表明，软件工程知识可以直接改进驱动这些变革的编程大语言模型。 我们认为，我们这个领域的角色非但不会削弱，反而必须扩展到开发这些模型本身。 我们为软件工程研究提出三项行动呼吁。

paragraphs.en: Evolve coding LLMs into software engineering LLMs. If post-training is programming with data [ 42 ] , software engineering must help write that program. The training data used to develop and refine coding LLMs shapes the engineering behaviors they acquire. Our field has decades of knowledge about how software should be designed, constructed, tested, and maintained. Research such as SWE-smith [ 65 ] already demonstrates the value of contributing training data directly to model development. RefactorForge extends this direction by using established refactoring knowledge to determine what the model practices and what constitutes a correct solution. This reflects the value of domain knowledge identified by Salsabil et al. [ 44 ] . SE researchers must bring their expertise into training-data construction, from selecting engineering operations to generating executable tasks and developing verification methods. These contributions can move us from coding LLMs toward software engineering LLMs, improving the engineering capabilities of the models themselves rather than only the systems built around them.
paragraphs.zh: 将代码大语言模型进化为软件工程大语言模型。 如果说后训练是用数据进行编程 [ 42 ]，那么软件工程必须帮助编写那个程序。 用于开发和改进代码大语言模型的训练数据决定了它们获得的工程行为。 我们领域在软件应如何设计、构建、测试和维护方面拥有数十年的知识积累。 诸如 SWE-smith [ 65 ] 之类的研究已经证明了直接为模型开发贡献训练数据的价值。 RefactorForge 延续了这一方向，利用既有的重构知识来确定模型练习的内容以及正确解的构成标准。 这体现了 Salsabil 等人 [ 44 ] 所识别出的领域知识的价值。 软件工程研究者必须将其专业知识带入训练数据的构建中，从选择工程操作到生成可执行任务以及开发验证方法。 这些贡献能推动我们从代码大语言模型走向软件工程大语言模型，提升模型自身的工程能力，而不仅仅是提升围绕模型构建的系统。

paragraphs.en: Apply SE to coding LLM development and maintenance. Developing coding LLMs requires more than generating training data. Prior work characterizes industrial post-training as brownfield maintenance, where teams update existing checkpoints under finite budgets while preserving established capabilities [ 42 ] . This introduces familiar SE challenges throughout model development, from training-data construction and integration to regression testing and release decisions. SE researchers must develop regression-aware methods that predict how training-data changes affect other capabilities without repeatedly running expensive benchmark suites. Early work on data-mixture performance prediction and proxy metrics provides promising foundations [ 66 , 38 ] . These methods should complement automated regression testing across model updates, workloads, and agent harnesses. Beyond regression testing, SE research must also advance methods for validating training data, ensuring reproducibility, tracing the effects of data changes, and managing model integration and releases. Together, these opportunities call for applying established SE principles throughout the model-development lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 将软件工程（SE）应用于编码大语言模型的开发与维护。 开发编码大语言模型不仅仅是生成训练数据。 已有研究将工业界的后训练刻画为棕地维护，即团队在有限预算下更新现有检查点，同时保留已建立的能力 [ 42 ] 。 这在整个模型开发过程中引入了人们熟悉的软件工程挑战，从训练数据的构建与集成，到回归测试与发布决策。 软件工程研究者必须开发具备回归感知的方法，在不反复运行昂贵基准套件的情况下，预测训练数据的变化会如何影响其他能力。 关于数据配比性能预测和代理指标的早期工作提供了有前景的基础 [ 66 , 38 ] 。 这些方法应当与跨模型更新、工作负载和智能体框架的自动化回归测试相互配合。 除回归测试之外，软件工程研究还必须推进验证训练数据、确保可复现性、追踪数据变化的影响以及管理模型集成与发布的方法。 总之，这些机遇要求在整个模型开发生命周期中应用成熟的软件工程原则。

paragraphs.en: Systematically define what coding LLMs should learn. Individual training interventions cannot address the breadth of capabilities required for SE. Our field needs a systematic account of what coding LLMs should learn and how to verify that they have learned it. SWEBOK provides a foundation by organizing established knowledge across requirements, design, construction, testing, maintenance, and other areas [ 57 ] . SE researchers must translate this knowledge into explicit engineering capabilities, their constituent operations, appropriate training tasks, and correctness criteria. These specifications must also identify relationships among capabilities and guide evaluations of acquisition and transfer. RefactorForge provides an initial example for refactoring, while its verification challenges demonstrate the work needed for more complex engineering activities. Such a research agenda would connect our field’s accumulated knowledge to the capabilities we develop in coding LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 系统性地定义编码大语言模型应当学习什么。 单一的训练干预无法覆盖软件工程所需的广泛能力。 我们领域需要一个系统性的阐述，说明编码大语言模型应当学习什么，以及如何验证它们已经学会了这些内容。 SWEBOK 通过组织需求、设计、构造、测试、维护及其他领域的既有知识，为此提供了基础 [ 57 ] 。 软件工程研究者必须将这些知识转化为明确的工程能力、其组成操作、合适的训练任务以及正确性标准。 这些规范还必须识别能力之间的关系，并指导对习得与迁移的评估。 RefactorForge 为重构提供了一个初步示例，而其验证难题则展示了开展更复杂工程活动所需的工作。 这样的研究议程将把我们领域积累的知识与我们为编码大语言模型开发的能力联系起来。

sents.zh: 软件工程研究者必须将这些知识转化为明确的工程能力、其组成操作、合适的训练任务以及正确性标准。

sents.en: These specifications must also identify relationships among capabilities and guide evaluations of acquisition and transfer.
sents.zh: 这些规范还必须识别能力之间的关系，并指导对习得与迁移的评估。

sents.en: RefactorForge provides an initial example for refactoring, while its verification challenges demonstrate the work needed for more complex engineering activities.
sents.zh: RefactorForge 为重构提供了一个初步示例，而其验证难题则展示了开展更复杂工程活动所需的工作。

sents.en: Such a research agenda would connect our field’s accumulated knowledge to the capabilities we develop in coding LLMs.
sents.zh: 这样的研究议程将把我们领域积累的知识与我们为编码大语言模型开发的能力联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Much of our community’s current research examines how to use coding LLMs in SE tasks [ 48 ] , how to evaluate their performance [ 28 ] , and where their capabilities remain insufficient [ 14 ] . These contributions remain essential, but our field has a larger role to play. We must move beyond studying and adapting to increasingly capable coding LLMs and actively contribute to their development. As coding LLMs increasingly engineer software, SE must help engineer the models themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们社区当前的研究很大一部分在考察如何在软件工程（SE）任务中使用代码大语言模型 [ 48 ]、如何评估其性能 [ 28 ]，以及它们的能力在哪些方面仍然不足 [ 14 ]。 这些贡献依然至关重要，但我们的领域还可以发挥更大的作用。 我们必须超越对日益强大的代码大语言模型的研究与适应，积极为其发展做出贡献。 随着代码大语言模型越来越多地从事软件工程工作，软件工程也必须反过来帮助构建模型本身。

sents.en: As coding LLMs increasingly engineer software, SE must help engineer the models themselves.
sents.zh: 随着代码大语言模型越来越多地从事软件工程工作，软件工程也必须反过来帮助构建模型本身。

paragraphs.en: Moving from coding LLMs to software engineering LLMs requires our field to shape both what models learn and how we develop them. Our industrial case study demonstrates one way to achieve this. Through RefactorForge, we applied established SE knowledge, tools, and verification practices to construct training data that improved refactoring and related issue-resolution performance across agent harnesses. We evaluated one 92B model and seven bounded refactoring types, predominantly renames. Constructing verified training data, fine-tuning large models, and evaluating their improvements require substantial engineering effort, computational resources, and financial investment. Our findings therefore provide an initial demonstration rather than evidence of generality across models and capabilities. We call on the SE community to systematically define the capabilities these models should acquire and apply its expertise throughout model training, evaluation, development, and maintenance.
paragraphs.zh: 从编码大语言模型走向软件工程大语言模型，需要我们的领域同时塑造模型学习的内容和我们开发模型的方式。 我们的工业案例研究展示了实现这一目标的一种途径。 通过 RefactorForge，我们将成熟的软件工程知识、工具和验证实践应用于构建训练数据，从而在多种智能体框架下提升了对重构及相关问题解决的表现。 我们评估了一个 92B 模型和七种有边界的重构类型，其中以重命名为主。 构建经验证的训练数据、微调大型模型并评估其改进，需要大量的工程投入、计算资源和资金投入。 因此，我们的发现只是一个初步示范，而非跨模型与跨能力普适性的证据。 我们呼吁软件工程社区系统地定义这些模型应当具备的能力，并在模型训练、评估、开发和维护的全过程中运用其专业知识。
